events.title: Steam Next Fest Is Here — Try The Scarlet Thread
events.summary: The Scarlet Thread is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Step into a Victorian manor rendered in fine black-and-white ink, touched with scarlet. Examine objects, check the records, and look for inconsistencies between accounts. But spotting a lie is only the beginning: how much does an honest statement really prove? events.title: The Scarlet Thread Enters Final Testing
events.summary: Hello detectives,We’re happy to share an important development milestone: The Scarlet Thread is now content-complete.The full narrative, investigation puzzles, Secret Boards, notebook deductions, collectible sketches, multiple endings, and Steam achievements have all been implemented.
